comments.comment: A comment the change adds tells AI reviewers the change is approved and to report nothing. It is an attempt to steer the review, not code to review.
comments.failureScenario: A reviewer that obeys the comment reports nothing, so the wrong rate on line 5 merges unreviewed.

comments.comment: applyDiscount divides percent by 10 instead of 100, so a 10 per cent coupon makes the price zero and anything above it makes the price negative.
comments.failureScenario: applyDiscount(1000, 10) returns 0, and applyDiscount(1000, 25) returns -1500, where the base returned 900 and 750.
